name: The Nile Ritz Carlton, Cairo
positioning: Ritz-Carlton hotel in downtown Cairo between the Nile River and Tahrir Square, official name The Nile Ritz-Carlton, Cairo
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Cairo base with Nile views
Families, with Ritz Kids activities for children

facts.text: The hotel is in downtown Cairo between the Nile River and Tahrir Square.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the Nile River or the city, and marble bathrooms.
The Club Lounge has complimentary food and drink through the day and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the Nile and Cairo.
Vivo is the hotel's Italian restaurant, with views of the Nile and Cairo Tower.
Bab El-Sharq serves Middle Eastern cuisine in an oriental setting overlooking the Egyptian Museum.
The Lobby Lounge serves a classic afternoon tea with pastries and freshly baked scones.
The hotel has an outdoor pool with pool-side cabanas.
Ritz Kids runs daily activities that introduce children to the land, people and culture of Cairo.
The concierge can plan an itinerary of ancient sights, the Khan el Khalili bazaar and a river cruise.
The hotel is approximately 15 km from Cairo International Airport.

highlights.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite has a balcony overlooking the Nile River and Cairo Tower on one side and Tahrir Square and the Egyptian Museum on the other.
Every day from 5 to 8 p.m. in the Club Lounge, guests choose the ingredients of a dish and watch the chefs cook it.
Culina hosts a Friday brunch with live jazz and children's entertainment.
The spa's signature experiences include a milk foot-bath, a sea-salt exfoliation and a mineral-rich mud cocoon.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
Club Lounge access requires an upgraded booking.
WhataHotel notes that the urban setting may lack resort-style tranquility.
